planning_contract.position_phase: deduplicate and sort the Position(manager, uint256 token id) closure over the complete WriterEvents envelope
planning_contract.completion_phase: after every planned Position result is resolved, derive getPool and Token-read identities from the immutable block-start planning projection, resolved new-position identity, and the selected segment NPM profile
planning_contract.full_envelope: scan every WriterEvent, including the suffix after any event that the diagnostic reducer later treats as fatal
planning_contract.planning_state: canonical domain-separated SHA-256 over sorted block-start Position identity fields required by planning
planning_contract.source_commitment: canonical prost encoding SHA-256 of the complete validated NpmSourceBlock
planning_contract.order: positions by manager and fixed-width token id; pools by factory, token0, token1, fee; tokens by ordinal and address
planning_contract.reasons: closed bit masks plus sorted unique contributing ordinals
planning_contract.multiplicity: Position and Pool maximum reducer consumption is exactly one per unique block-scoped cache key; Token maximum consumption is the role count for each ordinal/address key

preflight_contract.closed_frame: the resolved frame Position, Pool, and Token key sets must exactly equal the canonical plan before reducer invocation
preflight_contract.resolution: the call scope must pass the upstream payload-free Resolved gate before planning and every planned row must pass it before frame construction; PossibleReorg and Unknown abort
preflight_contract.authority: only a private-field PreflightedResolvedFrame can reach the certified planner/reducer entrypoint
preflight_contract.audit: every reducer-consumed request must be a subset of the plan and must not exceed planned multiplicity
preflight_contract.overplanning: resolved but unconsumed suffix rows are expected after early returns or fatal projection
preflight_contract.canonical_wire: prost round-trip equality rejects unknown and noncanonical bytes
